description: Every handler module (mailbox.rs, email.rs, submission.rs, identity.rs, vacation.rs) repeats the pattern: serde_json::to_value(se).unwrap_or_else(|e| json!({ "type": "serverFail", "description": e.to_string() })). This appears at least 30 times across the codebase. Idiomatic Rust would extract this into a small helper fn set_error_to_value(se: &SetError) -> Value (or impl From<SetError> for Value) so the intent is clear and the fallback is defined in one place. As-is a bug in the fallback path must be fixed in 30+ locations.
title: Repeated serde_json::to_value(se).unwrap_or_else pattern should be a helper
